title: Research pipeline SLOs: one config, a 2-hourly monitor + status files, one Telegram/ops-flags red flag per state change, brief §0 table, Saturday/Monday audits, same-day manager escalation
note: [2026-10-16 lane RESEARCH-PIPELINE-SLO-1016] Built on research_watchdog (15-min liveness) and RESEARCH-ENGINE-1016 (#18542). Baseline 2026-10-16T09:44Z (comms/research/health/2026-10-16.json, --no-gh): 9 ok / 5 breach / 2 could_not_look. Breaches: grade_latency_p90_d 7 (<=2, n=385), undispositioned_24h 38 (<=5: 19 ungraded + 19 needs_review unowned), programme_coverage_pct 45.8 (>=75: 22/48), theme_share_min_ratio 0.05 (>=0.5: infra 1 fire of 199 vs 9.5% weight; regime 0.42), research_ops_not_run 5 (<=2). could_not_look locally (no gh token): grader_age_h, hold_pr_wait_h -- hold_pr_wait measured separately via the GitHub API at ~177 h (#17182, open since 2026-10-09; 5 unit PRs open).  [2026-10-16 lane SLO-SCHEDULE-KEEPER-1016] The 12:53Z manual run delivered (telegram=true, ops-flags comment). The cron '41 */2 * * *' (merged 11:17Z, #18579) has NEVER fired on schedule: the 12:41Z and 14:41Z slots created no run; only manual dispatches exist (12:53Z, ~15:10Z). Remedy: research-slo.yml added to scripts/ops/schedule_keeper.py (stale_hours 3, self_dedupes). Stays landed_unproven. [2026-10-18 lane DISPATCH-MONEY-FIRST-1018] theme_share_min_ratio: the dispatcher now ranks due units ACROSS themes by value (operator 'money first'); THEMES weight only breaks ties, programme nodes count as asked units. Expect this SLO to recover more slowly / read red longer: a theme holding only low-value units fires on spare capacity or at starve_hours (240 h > the 7 d window). Threshold deliberately unchanged (research_slo.yaml comment says why); the lever is authoring valuable units in the short theme (H1-THEME), not the threshold. Row DISPATCH-MONEY-FIRST-1018.

observation.what: research-slo.yml runs on schedule in production, writes comms/research/health/<date>.json on main, a real (or planted via workflow_dispatch) breach delivers ONE Telegram system-channel message + ONE research-slo comment on the ops-flags PR (delivered.telegram true in runs[]), and GET /api/bot/work/brief shows the SLO table in §0 with researchSlo.readState=read; CLOSES ONLY when brief §0 shows the SLO table AND a SCHEDULED (event=schedule, not workflow_dispatch) run lands -- manual runs do not count (cron never fired as of 2026-10-16 15Z; schedule-keeper now covers it)
